svg.title: Bill of materials: toolbox and language composition
svg.desc: Toolbox: languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, C++, Python, HTML/CSS; frameworks: Next.js, React, React Native / Expo, Shopify / Liquid; data: MySQL / MariaDB; infra: Vercel, Windows Server, Linux, Git; security: Kali Linux, Burp Suite. Languages by bytes: TypeScript 31.7%, C# 29.8%, HTML 17.1%, Jupyter Notebook 7.5%, JavaScript 6.9%, Python 4.1%.
